title: ranunculus geminatus
intro: Ranunculus geminatus, commonly known as twin-flowered buttercup, is a plant species in the family Ranunculaceae. The health benefits of Ranunculus geminatus are not well documented, but it has been traditionally used to treat various ailments. The therapeutic actions of the plant are not extensively studied, but it is believed to have anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Ranunculus geminatus are not well defined, but it contains various alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids that contribute to its medicinal properties.
